104001: A ghost floats down a staircase and glides up to you. It floats there, flickering, regarding you. At last it speaks. "It is well that you came here, traveller. I can help you."
104002: The ghost continues. "I can make you strong, give you power - perhaps as much power as I have! But it will cost you dearly. I can give you skill at attack, defense, spellcasting, or knowledge... in return, I require the same. One for one. Are you interested?"
104003: "Ah, traveller, you will know one day that you have erred."
104004: "Of course. Who wouldn't be? I can teach you combat prowess or spell prowess. Do you prefer combat (attack or defense) or spells (spell power or knowledge)?"
104006: "Will it be spell power or knowledge?"
104007: "Will you pay me with your attack skill?"
104008: "Will you pay me with your defense skill?"
104009: "Will you pay me with your spell power?"
104010: "Will you pay me with your knowledge?"
104011: "Then you have nothing to pay me! Begone!"
104012: "You can't trick me! You have none to pay!"
104013: The ghost admires its handiwork. "Your new powers are affecting you. I can see the change already..."
